description: Four units whose extension substream header CRC is wrong.

skip.ffprobe_bitrate: ffmpeg's lossless decoder sets the bit rate to 0 (dca_xll.c: avctx->bit_rate = 0), so ffprobe lists none
skip.decode: ffmpeg checks the extension substream header's CRC-16 and rejects it (dca_exss.c: 'Invalid EXSS header checksum'); its parser names the profile from the asset descriptor without that check (dca_parser.c)
